title: test(spec): tombstoned-row-status floor at two thirds of the measured population (48 → 32)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBJX2Ccg4np4Pe7mp48hmBn1)_
Fixes #26541

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`tombstoned-row-status` 活性测试的防空底线从 40 降到 32，只改这一个测试文件。
- 为什么改：底线等于实测墓碑数，按 ADR-0087 正常退役一个墓碑键就会误红；今天实测已是 48，底线取约三分之二。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽一个下限，主断言（墓碑键必须 `dead`、必须 `never` 类型）不动；回滚即还原这一行。
- 先看：`packages/spec/scripts/liveness/tombstoned-row-status.test.ts` 的 `TOMBSTONE_FLOOR` 一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run scripts/liveness/tombstoned-row-status.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`TOMBSTONE_FLOOR` in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/tombstoned-row-status.test.ts` moves from 40 to 32, with a comment naming the measured value and the date. This follows the parent #26444 rule (about two thirds of the measured population, rounded down; precedent `vite-dts-wiring-ratchet`, measured 22, floor 15). The stale inline comment "40 was the measured population" is reworded. The file header's history paragraph (40 at pin time) is left as the historical record it is.

**Measured population on base `1c632311`: 48** top-level `[REMOVED]` keys, all 48 `dead`. The floor is floor(48 × 2/3) = 32. **Margin: 16 tombstones (one third)** can be retired before the floor is reached.

No changeset: the file lives under `packages/spec/scripts/`, which is not in `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` (`dist`, `json-schema`, `liveness`, `prompts`, `src/**/*.zod.ts`, …), so nothing publishes. Labelled `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/liveness/` in `packages/spec` on the change: Test Files 12 passed (12), Tests 358 passed (358).

## Acceptance notes

Non-vacuity kept. Two one-off mutations of `collectTombstones()`'s `return out;` on the committed fix, each restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and proved restored by an empty `git diff HEAD` (no test file left behind):

<details><summary>Mutation legs</summary>

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| population emptied | `return [];` | exit 1, `AssertionError: expected 0 to be greater than or equal to 32`, Tests 1 failed / 2 passed |
| one tombstone dropped | `return out.slice(1);` (47) | exit 0, Tests 3 passed |

</details>

## Verification

Local derived gate subset (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) is reported in the os-dev report comment on #26541; every CI family reads from this PR's check-runs.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
